meta.title: EcoAgta EZ3+ — Triple Acting Organic Farm Input
meta.description: EcoAgta EZ3+ helps control and deter whiteflies and helps prevent sooty mold fungus, while promoting healthier growth. Non-toxic, readily biodegradable green chemistry from CraftDyne.

ez3plus.name: EcoAgta EZ3+
ez3plus.tagline: One spray. Three actions. Up to six months of protection.
ez3plus.intro: EZ3+ is CraftDyne's flagship green-chemistry farm input. It addresses the whitefly problem and the sooty mold that follows it, while supporting the plant's own growth and immunity — from a single application, using chemistry designed to break down cleanly.

whiteflies.title: Helps control and deter whiteflies
whiteflies.description: Acts on the pest that drives both direct feeding damage and the honeydew behind sooty mold.

sootyMold.title: Helps prevent sooty mold fungus
sootyMold.description: Interrupts the cycle where honeydew deposits become a black fungal film that blocks photosynthesis.

growth.title: Promotes healthier plant growth
growth.description: Supports vigour and canopy development through the protected period.

productivity.title: Supports higher crop productivity
productivity.description: Healthier, less-stressed plants hold their yield potential through the season.

safety.title: Safe for people, animals and the environment
safety.description: Non-toxic and non-poisonous, with no harm to the food chain.

howItWorks.heading: How the triple action works
howItWorks.description: Whitefly damage is rarely just the insect. Feeding weakens the plant, the honeydew it excretes feeds sooty mold, and the mold then blocks the light the plant needs. EZ3+ is formulated to act at all three points rather than only the first.

deter.title: Deter the pest
deter.description: Helps control and deter whiteflies, reducing feeding pressure before an infestation establishes.

prevent.title: Prevent the secondary infection
prevent.description: Helps prevent the sooty mold fungus that colonises honeydew residue on leaves and fruit.

promote.title: Promote the plant
promote.description: Supports growth, vigour, immunity and yield, and provides systemic protection against pathogens.

crops.label: Suitable for
crops.value: Vegetable, fruit, plantation and field crops

foodChain.label: Food chain
foodChain.value: No harm to the food chain

residue.label: Air, water and soil
residue.value: No harm to air, water or soil

application.heading: Using EZ3+
application.description: EZ3+ is applied as a foliar spray using standard equipment, so it fits existing routines without new machinery or training.
application.notice: Dosage and spray interval depend on crop, growth stage and local pest pressure. Our team will recommend a schedule for your crop and region — please get in touch before first use, and always read the product label.

howLong.question: How long does one application last?
howLong.answer: CraftDyne states that a single spray provides up to six months of protection. Actual duration varies with crop, climate, growth stage and local pest pressure, so treat six months as an upper figure rather than a guarantee and confirm a schedule for your conditions with our team.

organic.question: Is EZ3+ suitable for organic farming?
organic.answer: EZ3+ is described by CraftDyne as a triple acting organic farm input, formulated on IUPAC Green Chemistry principles and completely readily biodegradable. Organic certification requirements differ between certifying bodies and export markets, so please contact us with the certification scheme you work under before using it in a certified system.

safety.question: Is it safe around people and animals?
safety.answer: EZ3+ is formulated to be non-toxic and non-poisonous, with no harm to the food chain and no harm to air, water or soil. Standard good practice when spraying any farm input still applies — follow the directions on the product label.

crops.question: Which crops can it be used on?
crops.answer: EZ3+ is intended for vegetable, fruit, plantation and field crops. If your crop is not listed on our applications page, contact us and we will advise whether it is suitable.

mixing.question: Can it be tank-mixed with other inputs?
mixing.answer: Compatibility depends on what else you are applying. Please check with our team before tank-mixing so we can confirm there is no interaction that would reduce performance.

buy.question: How do I buy EZ3+ or become a distributor?
buy.answer: Contact us by phone, WhatsApp or the enquiry form. We work with farmers directly and with agri-input dealers and distributors across India and in export markets.

cta.title: Interested in EZ3+ for your crop?
cta.description: Tell us your crop, area and location, and we will come back with an application recommendation.

meta.title: EcoAgta Blumenn Strong Super Concentrate — Premature Fruit Drop Prevention
meta.description: Blumenn Strong Super Concentrate prevents premature fruit drop, increases yield, and provides systemic protection & insect repellency. Made with Green Chemistry principles.

blumennStrong.name: EcoAgta Blumenn Strong Super Concentrate
blumennStrong.kicker: For Preventing Premature Fruit Drop & Increasing Yield
blumennStrong.tagline: Systemic Protection, Immunity & Yield Enhancement for Fruit & Plantation Crops.
blumennStrong.intro: EcoAgta Blumenn Strong Super Concentrate is formulated using IUPAC Green Chemistry principles to address both internal and external root causes of premature fruit drop. It increases viable fruit, enhances plant immunity, and repels insects & fungal pathogens while causing ZERO harm to air, water, soil, and the food chain.

drop.title: Prevents Premature Fruit Drop
drop.description: Addresses abscission layer formation, ovule degeneration, and fruitlet competition to retain viable fruit.

yield.title: Increases Farm Yield & Savings
yield.description: Saves farming costs over longer protection periods and significantly boosts usable harvest volume.

immunity.title: Provides Systemic Protection
immunity.description: Strengthens internal plant immunity against fungal pathogens like Powdery Mildew and Anthracnose.

decay.title: Insect & Fungal Repellency
decay.description: Deters sap-sucking insects like Leaf Hoppers and Mealybugs alongside fungal infections.

safety.title: 100% Non-toxic & Readily Biodegradable
safety.description: Safe for applicators, livestock, wildlife, and natural water bodies.

causes.heading: Underlying Causes Addressed
causes.sub: Blumenn Strong works on both internal physiological stress and external pest/disease pressure.

internal.abscission: Formation of abscission layer at fruit attachment point

external.fungal: High incidence of fungal diseases (Powdery Mildew, Anthracnose)
external.suckers: High incidence of Leaf Hoppers and Mealybugs (Sap Suckers)

dilution.heading: Dilution & Spray Recommendations
dilution.description: Follow recommended dilution rates using clean fresh well or stream water for best efficacy.
dilution.ratioTitle: Dilution Ratio for Tree & Plantation Crops
dilution.ratioExample: 1 : 2000 (Example: 100 mL in 200 Liters of fresh non-chlorinated water)
dilution.waterType: Mix thoroughly for 10 minutes in a clean drum. Wash and rinse all contents into the mixing drum.

usage.timingBody: Preferably spray between 6:00 AM – 10:30 AM or 3:30 PM – 6:30 PM for optimal foliar absorption.
usage.coverage: Spray thoroughly to cover all leaves and plant parts. Apply symptomatically at first sight of insects or fungi.

safety.heading: Safety & Eco-Compatibility
safety.notice: Non-poisonous, non-fuming, non-irritating to persons and animals. Readily biodegradable with zero environmental burden. Always wash hands after handling.

purpose.question: What is the primary function of Blumenn Strong Super Concentrate?
purpose.answer: Blumenn Strong is specifically formulated to prevent premature fruit drop, increase viable fruit retention, and boost overall harvest yield.

crops.question: Which crops benefit most from Blumenn Strong?
crops.answer: It is ideal for Tree and Plantation crops such as Guava, Mango, Coconut, Lemon, Lime, and Tapioca.

dilution.question: What is the recommended dosage and dilution?
dilution.answer: The recommended dilution is 1:2000 (e.g., 100 mL in 200 Liters of water). Ensure thorough mixing in non-chlorinated fresh water.

safety.question: Is Blumenn Strong safe for animals and the environment?
safety.answer: Yes. It is made according to IUPAC Green Chemistry principles, completely non-toxic, readily biodegradable, and leaves ZERO harmful residues in air, water, soil, or the food chain.
